project.name: WoGu Sample: Temporal Project
project.description:
Demonstrates wogu-maven-plugin against real Temporal Java SDK code. The 'clean' module uses Workflow.randomUUID() and passes 'mvn verify'; the 'violation' module uses UUID.randomUUID() inside a workflow implementation and intentionally fails 'mvn verify', with an HTML report written to target/wogu/index.html.
This aggregator (and its children) is intentionally excluded from the repo's default reactor build (see the root pom's 'with-samples' profile), since 'violation' fails by design. Run it explicitly: mvn -f sample-temporal-project/clean verify mvn -f sample-temporal-project/violation verify
